scope: Review and refinement of the preceding aesthetic work, focused on usable compact inspector content and aligned metadata.
findings_and_changes: At the minimum window the old inspector left only 64 logical points for content. The new window uses the available height with tighter title/body margins and retains a close control and fixed tabs.

Below 500 logical points in viewport height, histogram and preview are collapsible; copy/paste and final-render actions move to Actions. Before/After and the Exposure input are immediately visible on the tested neutral PNG.
Metadata names now align left. Portrait previews fit in a maximum 220-point height without cropping, preserving room for File fields.

verification.negative_regression: Before correction the Format field was clipped at 550x360; see compact-before.log.
verification.positive_regression: IT/EN, populated preview/histogram, metadata and Exposure visible at 550x360; actual 0.75 EV entry creates one saved generation; Actions copy/paste/final-render controls reachable. File fields visible for a 1:6 portrait at 1440x940. Existing tab/draft/selection/zoom regressions pass.

visually_reviewed: Final viewer, grid, performance preferences and compact navigator.
Compact Information/Develop IT/EN at 200%, plus compact grid Information in both languages; normal Information with aligned File metadata.
limitations: No native Windows repetition or extended accessibility/display qualification; three private RAW tests skipped.
Interactions verified using egui input events; native captures show initial content. RAW controls and expanded histogram still require scrolling in a short window.
Wide native viewport constrained by macOS to 1440x891; compact viewport 550x360 logical at 200% UI zoom.
Ad hoc signing and these XPC checks do not establish release or full sandbox guarantees. No SF or R0–R4 gates closed.
